title: Refuse a shape or merged approval whose CONTEXT.md has no read set
action: Add `parse_read_set(text: &str) -> Option<Vec<String>>` to context_table.rs beside `parse_locked_decision_ids` (context_table.rs:23 `pub(crate) fn parse_locked_decision_ids(text: &str) -> Option<Vec<String>> {`), the same prefix-tolerant shape (reuse its loop, `is_separator_row` and `skip_table`): find the `## Read set` heading, then before the next `## ` heading the first pipe table whose header row starts with `| Concept |`, and return its first-column cells trimmed of backticks; `None` when the heading or the table is absent (per D2; grammar fixed in plan.md Approach). Add `read_set_refusal(root: &Path, feature: &str) -> Option<String>` in plan_packets.rs beside `claims_refusal`, copying its skeleton: exempt `tiny|small|docs` lanes exactly as plan_packets.rs:584 does (`let is_exempt = matches!(mode.as_deref(), Some("tiny") | Some("small") | Some("docs"));`), resolve `docs/history/<feature>/CONTEXT.md` the worktree-aware way `advisor_plan_path` resolves plan.md; a CONTEXT.md that cannot be read refuses, naming the path it looked for; when the file carries a `<!-- bee:no-read-set: <reason> -->` marker anywhere return None (the marker in the file is the record; add no gate output field); when `parse_read_set` is None refuse with this message shape: `gate: approval refused — docs/history/<feature>/CONTEXT.md has no "## Read set" section. FIX: run \`bee knowledge context --work <feature>\` and \`bee knowledge search --text "<topic>"\`, write the section (skills/bee-shaping/references/context-template.md), or add \`<!-- bee:no-read-set: <reason> -->\` for a CONTEXT.md written before the read set existed.`; an empty knowledge table (section present, zero rows) passes; when any returned path does not start with `docs/knowledge/` or does not exist under the repo root, refuse naming that path and the remedy (fix the path or remove the row). Call `read_set_refusal` at exactly ONE site: the pre-lock peek where `plan_claims_refusal` already runs for `shape` and `--merge` approvals (set_gate.rs:934 `if let Some(msg) = plan_claims_refusal(root, &peek, lane) {`), right after it, never on a plain `--name execution` (per D2). Write the seven test-matrix rows for kdf-1 as tests whose fn names contain `read_set`: the parser cases in drivers/tests.rs beside the existing CONTEXT.md fixture helper (drivers/tests.rs:6332 `fn write_locked_decisions_table(root: &Path, feature: &str, ids: &[&str]) {`), the gate approval cases in state_group/tests.rs beside the existing gate approval tests. No code comments. Do not touch brief.rs or the prompt renderer (per D5). A knowledge-table row whose first cell is wrapped in parentheses (the template's no-bundle form `| (no bundle) | — | this host has no docs/knowledge/ |`) is a note row: parse_read_set skips it and it never refuses.
